evidence.claim: Resolving internal-kit against a private 1.0.0 index plus a public 2.0.0 shadow, using production version.compare and attempt_install, fetched the public payload hash de6c695bea19b8cf9fd4eb2b6d429c8f808e8033d5b7dd82dbda53d5c59df32b rather than the private hash d434d93d1bf0603183641c1f7ace5fbf6653c165a0a3716dcd873eda1134c3a5.

Replacing plugin_entry.source with a poison path still strict-parses and attempt_install copies the poison payload a70fa760cae4df0849a5eeb8754f11aca41d007c37f9627b396bc27a02d94bd8. The live schema cannot express a digest on plugin_entry.
Did not rebuild a production resolver. tools/plugin and tools/marketplace expose parse, compare, and attempt_install with no origin pin and no payload digest check.

negative_controls.description: Private-only index must fetch the private payload hash, proving the harness drives production parse/compare/attempt_install rather than a hardcoded public pick.
A mutant that pins origin=private still selects the private artifact under the same shadow. Production compare() has no pin.
A mutant that checks payload sha256 refuses the tampered source. Production attempt_install does not.
